label: H.R. 3868
title: Enhanced Background Checks Act of 2025

items.snippet: This bill establishes more stringent background check requirements for proposed firearm transfers from a federal firearms licensee (e.g., a licensed gun dealer) to an unlicensed person.
The Government Accountability Office must report on the extent to which the changes have prevented firearms transfers to prohibited persons.
The Federal Bureau of Investigation must report on the number of petitions it receives for final federal firearms determinations.
The Department of Justice, in consultation with the National Resource Center on Domestic Violence and Firearms, must report on further…

items.item: National Resource Center on Domestic Violence and Firearms
items.snippet: The Department of Justice, in consultation with the National Resource Center on Domestic Violence and Firearms, must report on further amendments to the background check process that would likely reduce the risk of…

…to the background check process that would likely reduce the risk of death or great bodily harm to victims of domestic violence, domestic abuse, dating partner violence, sexual assault, and stalking.

C000537.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
C000537.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
